dataList.content:
<color=#cc2424>Nay, tease me not, jest me not as though my venture is one for fools.</color>
<color=#cc2424>不，别当我像个笨蛋似的嘲弄我。</color>

<color=#cc2424>I have already explained that you do not know of true adventure.</color>
<color=#cc2424>那是因为你不懂冒险所以才会这么说。</color>

<color=#cc2424>We shall soon walk a path of suffering, its intensity unprecedented and monumental.</color>
<color=#cc2424>我们即将进行一场史无前例的炽烈苦行。</color>

<color=#cc2424>Do you not see the grand gate of adventure risen, unlatched before us?</color>
<color=#cc2424>你没看见吗，伟大冒险的大门正向我们敞开。</color>

<color=#cc2424>Thus, silence your prattling and resume the preparations; let us leave posthaste.</color>
<color=#cc2424>因此废话少说，收拾行装准备出发吧。</color>

<color=#ffef23>…….</color>
<color=#ffef23>……</color>

<color=#ffef23>... This is quite odd, however.</color>
<color=#ffef23>但是，这有些奇怪。</color>

<color=#ffef23>……. </color>
<color=#ffef23>……</color>

<color=#ffef23>Since when was Rocinante given the gift of speech?</color>
<color=#ffef23>驽骍难得是何时开始说话的？</color>

While we had our reservations, we took the path Sansón opened for us and made it to the next Area.
虽然心里多少感觉不对劲，但通过参孙为我们开辟的道路，我们终归是得以前往下一区域。
dataList.place:
La Manchaland, Area 2
拉·曼却领 2区

dataList.content:
I'm worried about Xichun and the other Fixers. They were assigned Area 2, right? I hope they're alright...
真让人担心。听说包括惜春小姐在内的多位收尾人前往了2区，不知他们是否安然无恙……

Xichun will be okay, I'm sure. Oh, that reminds me... I have a funny family in-joke to share...
惜春会没事的。啊，还有一个与此相关的戏言……

Oho, let's hear it.
哦吼，是什么啊？

It goes like this. Any of our siblings who managed to survive on their own up to the age of thirteen in our household will probably be a-okay even if they were to be tossed out to the middle of the Outskirts! Hehe...
据传在我们家中独自活过十三岁的兄弟姐妹们，哪怕是被扔到郊区中央也能存活。呼呼……

... Ahm. Okay, we should hurry. I bet Area 2's just as bad... if not worse, than Area 1. If something bad were to happen to your sister in front your eyes—
……咳咳，我们是不是该再快一点？这里的危险程度比起1区肯定只增不减。要是你妹妹在你眼前遭遇不测的话……

Then I will gather her remains and lay them in her final resting place when I return home, whenever that may be.
那样的话，我至少得帮她善后，到时候能回家的话再把她安置好。

Xichun would have done the same for me.
想必惜春也会这样对我的。

... Yeah?
……这样嘛。

... Anyways~ Whew! Ain't this place a bit drafty, fellas?
呃~话说回来是不是……有点冷啊？大伙？

This place feels very different from Area 1.
……这里的气氛和1区不一样。

Unlike Area 1, which was extremely gaudy and overtly decorated...
不同于先前那个费尽心思进行华丽装潢的场所……

... this place is teeming with ominous, depressing silence.
这里阴郁、寂静，像是荒凉之地一般。

Yeah. This place is... how should I put it... It's eerily quiet. Almost spooky, even...
这里……感觉是有些凉飕飕的……还环绕着不祥的寂静……

Welp, I hope this is the good kind of quiet~
我倒希望是乐观意义上的寂静呢~

Y'know, what if it's just quiet down here because the Fixers who made it here first already took out all the Bloodfiends?
例如说先来到这里的收尾人们已经提前把事情都料理好了，所以遇不到任何血魔之类的……

<It is pretty suffocating to just sit here, not knowing who won the fight... or if there even was a fight.>
<不知道都有谁还活着，真让人郁闷。>

Let's try not to get added to that wall of missing persons posters...
只求我们不会成为那些寻人启事之中的一员吧……

How much time do we have until La Manchaland closes?

距离拉·曼却领关闭还有几个小时呢？

Five hours, by my estimation.
大约5小时。

Nice, nice. I'd say we're moving at a decent pace. Hey, what if we're the first group that managed to activate their Area's device?
好呀，好呀。进展还蛮顺利的。我们不会是最快启动装置的队伍吧？

Well, we did suffer some losses...
虽说出现了减员……

Losses? I believe we've only pruned a traitor in our midst.
减员？叛徒根本配不上这种说法。

Yet... aught sits ill at the back of my mind still.
有件事一直令我在意。

It was not as though we passed the first Area by our own will and effort; it was the command of the man in his magician's outfit by which we were 'made' to pass through.
我们似乎并未真正通过1区……而是被那魔术师装扮的人所放行……

Well... he was a pretty weird Bloodfiend.
怎么说呢……他确实是个有些奇怪的血魔。

R-right? And... I couldn't quite tell what it was, but there was something familiar about him...
没、没错。而且还有种似曾相识的感觉……

Something familiar? Hm, I guess he did seem kinda similar to Ryōshū, in that artsy-fartsy way.
有这回事？我猜因为他看起来挺艺术的，所以和良秀有些相似吧。

Ryōshū quietly let out a cloud of smoke. It briefly lingered midair before turning into a bizarre shape.
良秀只是无言地吐出了大量的烟气，并将烟气弄成了奇怪的模样。

T-that's cute... is that a cat-shaped plume?
真、真可爱……是小猫吗？

Hoo... It's you. Weeping and sniveling.
呼……这是你哭哭啼啼的模样。

An expression of the consequences, should you mistranslate me in the future.
描绘的是你口译失误时会发生的场面。

Ooh...? Huh, this place is pretty neat.
噢……？这里还挺特别的。

<Ooh, what is it?>
<哦哦，发现什么了？>

Look here, on the map. They have an infirmary.
瞧瞧这个。这地图上好像还标有医务室之类的地方啊。

'Guests injured on a ride, guests who need a moment to calm down, or any Bloodfiends who are in urgent need of blood, you can find help here!'...
请各位在游玩设施的过程中受伤的游客、受到过度惊吓的游客、以及急需血液的血魔来此处接受帮助……

Huh, ain't that awfully nice of them.
呵，真是令人倍感亲切的文章……

They said that La Manchaland was intended to be where Bloodfiends and humans can peacefully, happily coexist.
他们说拉·曼却领……建立的初衷是为了提供让血魔与人类能够幸福地生活在一起的空间。

Maybe... a long, long time ago... it really did work for a while. At least according to the descriptions on this map.
只看这地图上的说明的话……说不定很久以前……真的是如他们所愿的那种地方呢。

Nonsense! 'Twould be an impossible task, most evidently!
此乃何言！那不可能顺利实现！

An adventure such as this cannot possibly exist in any tale of Don Quixote. A place to coexist with villains...? Pah, absurd...
那是在堂吉诃德的词典中不会存在的冒险。什么与恶人们一起幸福地生活下去的地方……

Hmm, this subject doth remind me of a case Lord Siegfried had once resolved.
嗯，如此说来，吾回忆起一件齐格飞大人曾经解决过的事件。

A battle atop a bridge, it was! Back then, the villains suggested a compromise most devious, not unlike the one suggested by the wicked ones who inhabit this place.
那是一场于桥上开展的战斗……而那时恶人们也给出了十分狡诈的提案。

They sought to seduce him with promises of riches and power, to have him stand with them!
他们用金钱与权力压迫齐格飞大人，诱惑他成为他们的同伴！

Yet Lord Siegfried refused to bend his knee!
但是吾等的齐格飞大人绝不会因此而被诱惑！

He answered their suggestion with but a mighty socking against the villain's jaw...!
他向着说出可恶提案的恶人脸上挥出了超级一拳……！

Oh, that one-hour edit of the 'battle'? Wasn't it pretty obvious that it was staged—
呃，那个1小时的剪辑影像么？那个明明一看就是剧本……

... and declared thusly!
然后如此说道！

'Thou shan't make a purchasable product of I, Siegfried, with thy contemptible money!'
“汝等竟认为用区区一点脏钱就能收买吾齐格飞！”

AND! Fired off his super special laser beam cannon at the villain! ZWAAAAAHHHH—
他如此说道，用超级射线对着那个人滋滋滋滋滋……

Attention, men.
好了，所有人注意看这里。

... A timely intervention from Outis put a stop to Don Quixote's story.
……奥提斯在恰到好处的时机打断了堂吉诃德的故事。

There are remains of Bloodbags strewn about in close proximity to this attraction.
血袋的痕迹集中在这座游乐设施。

It's called... let's see. 'Haunted: Bloody Mary'...
其名为……鬼屋·血腥玛丽。

Hm. Is this one of those, uh, 'haunted mansion' attractions?
哎，看来是鬼屋之类的啊。

Hey, Sinclair. Do ya think these haunted mansions have actual—
啊，辛克莱。鬼屋里是有真的幽灵……

S-stop right there! Hey, my parents took me to an amusement park too, okay? S-so don't think you can use this to tease me or scare me like—
等、等下！我小时候也是和家人们一起去过游乐园的！所……所以就算这样唬我，我也不会上钩……

... It was a genuine question. I've never been to an amusement park, you know.
……我就是想问问来着。我这是第一次来游乐园……

Ahh...
咳……

I-I'm sorry.
对、对不起。

Eh, don'tcha worry about it! So, do these places actually have ghosts or nah?
欸~没事啦。所以说是有真的幽灵出没吗？

I-I'm fairly sure they have some pretty cheap-looking animatronics or mannequins at worst.
通……通常来说也就是会蹦出一些破破烂烂的人偶而已。

As attractions of that category often admit guests of all ages, including children, they do not place real paranatural entities such as ghosts inside them. However, they often install various tools and visual effects to stimulate fear responses in their guests.
由于是可供儿童游玩的游乐设施，所以不会配有真正的幽灵。只会设置造成恐惧的装置。

Yeah, these are usually family attractions.
是的，毕竟是家庭游乐的场所。

<color=#cc2424>Where's your family? Your siblings?</color>
<color=#cc2424>你没有家人或是手足吗？</color>

<color=#ffef23>I never had anyone, not even on the day I was born. I've only known... the cold... the loneliness...</color>
<color=#ffef23>我生来就是孑然一身。总是寒冷而寂寞……</color>

<color=#cc2424>Then let me…</color>
<color=#cc2424>那就让我……</color>

<color=#cc2424>... grant you the will to live.</color>
<color=#cc2424>给予你活下去的意愿。</color>

<color=#cc2424>The family I shall grant you will forever be by your side. Come with me.</color>
<color=#cc2424>给予你会永远陪伴你身旁的家人，跟我来。</color>
